name: What is the process for installing recessed lighting in an existing ceiling?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing recessed lighting in an existing ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing recessed lighting in an existing ceiling typically involves cutting holes for the fixtures, running new wiring through the ceiling joists, connecting to an existing power source, and then securing the fixtures. Our team will carefully assess your ceiling structure and access points. Preparation often involves clearing the work area and ensuring attic or crawl space access if needed, which can affect the overall installation time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing recessed lighting involves cutting holes, running new wiring, connecting to power, and securing fixtures. Access to the ceiling joists is often required.
